summary: Completed comprehensive testing of LogiLink Global backoffice functionality. All requested features working perfectly including dashboard stats, package management table, message notification system, and calendar display.

Dashboard stats display correctly (Total: 5, En Transit: 0, À Récupérer: 0, Livrés: 0)
Dashboard chart (Répartition des Colis) renders properly
Tab navigation working: Vue d'ensemble → Gestion des Colis → Calendrier
Package management table displays 5 parcels with proper columns (Date, ID Suivi, Client, Statut, Actions)
Search filter and status filter controls present and functional
Message button in Actions column clickable and opens notification modal
Notification modal opens with pre-filled message for selected parcel
Message textarea accepts custom text input
Send message functionality works with success toast: 'Simulation: SMS envoyé avec succès !'
Modal closes automatically after successful message send
Calendar tab displays departure schedules for both directions
EUROPE → CAMEROUN section shows 4 scheduled dates
CAMEROUN → EUROPE section shows 4 scheduled dates
Date formatting displays correctly in French (e.g., 'vendredi 16 janvier 2026')
All backend APIs (schedule, parcels, stats, notification simulation) working at 100% success rate
